main_text.head: VIRIS MAGNIFICIS, AMPLISSIMIS, ILLVSTRIBVS, NOBILISSIMIS, DN. DN. CONSVLIBVS, SENATORIBVS, Adeoque Toti SENATVI inclytæ REIPUBLICÆ GENEVENSIS.
main_text.p: Nec Non EXCELLENTISSIMIS AC CELEBERRIMIS VIRIS, DN. DN. PASTORIBVS, PROFESSORIBVS, Ecclesiæ & Academiæ GENEVENSIS Doctissimis ac Meritissimis,

Dominis suis gratiosissimis, Præceptoribus Maximis; Benevolis omni honoris cultu prosequendis: cum officiosa hujus Dissertationis inscriptione, se suaque omnia, dum sui memor erit, mancipata, profitetur & attestatur, AUTOR.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page (faint mirrored title text, "DE ... PRÆCEPTIS ... DE ... LXXVII") is omitted. The spelling "Adeoque" and "Dominis" are copied as printed; "cultu-prosequendis" shows a printed hyphen at the line end, rendered as printed. Some words in the italic closing paragraph are slightly uncertain.
